description: Default vs best-scoring microstate validity of the original poses
row_grain: one row per (dataset, seed, target, ligand)

columns.name: dataset
columns.description: ten_target_main / ten_target_budget6 = original runs re-checked; dude_full / litpcba / zinc_unmatched / zinc_charge_mismatch = decoy-matching ligand sets

columns.name: seed
columns.description: docking seed of the original run (directory name); ALL = pooled

columns.name: target
columns.description: receptor target; ALL = pooled over targets

columns.name: ligand_idx
columns.description: row index of the ligand in the original run

columns.name: n_micro
columns.description: microstates with a docked pose (and a PoseBusters verdict)

columns.name: has_default
columns.description: the default microstate was docked

columns.name: best_microstate
columns.description: microstate of the lowest Vina score among the docked microstates

columns.name: best_score
columns.description: lowest Vina score of the ligand

columns.name: default_microstate
columns.description: default microstate id (original: first candidate of the single strategy; decoy-matching: order 0)

columns.name: default_score
columns.description: Vina score of the default microstate's representative pose

columns.name: best_is_default
columns.description: best-scoring microstate equals the default microstate

columns.name: gain
columns.description: default_score - best_score (>= 0)

columns.name: default_geom
columns.description: verdict of the default microstate's representative pose under geom

columns.name: best_geom
columns.description: verdict of the best-scoring microstate's representative pose under geom

columns.name: flip_geom
columns.description: default and best microstate differ in validity under geom

columns.name: rescue_geom
columns.description: default invalid and best valid under geom

columns.name: degrade_geom
columns.description: default valid and best invalid under geom

columns.name: default_full_pb
columns.description: verdict of the default microstate's representative pose under full_pb

columns.name: best_full_pb
columns.description: verdict of the best-scoring microstate's representative pose under full_pb

columns.name: flip_full_pb
columns.description: default and best microstate differ in validity under full_pb

columns.name: rescue_full_pb
columns.description: default invalid and best valid under full_pb

columns.name: degrade_full_pb
columns.description: default valid and best invalid under full_pb

columns.name: default_score_rank
columns.description: verdict of the default microstate's representative pose under score_rank

columns.name: best_score_rank
columns.description: verdict of the best-scoring microstate's representative pose under score_rank

columns.name: flip_score_rank
columns.description: default and best microstate differ in validity under score_rank

columns.name: rescue_score_rank
columns.description: default invalid and best valid under score_rank

columns.name: degrade_score_rank
columns.description: default valid and best invalid under score_rank

columns.name: compound_id
columns.description: original ledger compound id

columns.name: label
columns.description: 1 = active, 0 = decoy (original run)

columns.name: source
columns.description: original run ligand source (active / decoy)
